text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry!
I was just doing some squats!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I got plenty of sleep last night,
but power is just surging through my whole body...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't just sit still!!
All of this power, every last bit of it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —I want to pour it into my hamstrings!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I can't just sit still!
Excuse me, but I'm gonna keep going!

...At any rate, it seems Mejiro Ryan
is completely full of energy again!
